verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a full webhooks system for subscribing to event notifications: up to 10 URLs per app, scoped event types, durable retry delivery (up to 25 attempts over 3 days), and signature verification guidance. This directly matches the story of subscribing to events via webhooks for an AI-native/agentic workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation tying webhook events to the agentic-commerce/cart flows specifically (e.g., cart or checkout completion events) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond PayPal's own docs.
